''See also: [[Sage of the Endless Sword Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Sage]] of the [[Endless Sword]] was a powerful martial artist and master of the [[Path of the Endless Sword]]. He was known for his wisdom and for hand-selecting a disciple, [[Yerin|Yerin Arelius]], to inherit his specialized fighting style. His [[Path]] focuses on using [[madra]] to create weapons or reinforce limbs, specifically utilizing [[sword aura]] that grows stronger as it moves. A core component of his mastery is the [[Endless Sword]], a [[Ruler technique]] that serves as the foundation for his [[Path]]. This technique allows a practitioner to manifest numerous invisible blades or concentrated bursts of aura that can strike multiple targets simultaneously. While the [[Sage]] was a highly respected figure, he was eventually killed, leaving his disciple to preserve his legacy. His combat philosophy emphasized a lack of mercy toward enemies alongside the importance of acting without regret. He also believed that the pursuit of perfection in [[sacred arts]] was a solitary endeavor. Following his death, fragments of his wisdom and insights into his [[Path]] remain accessible through the memories ingrained in his spirit remnants, which his disciple continues to study to refine her techniques.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The [[Sage]] of the [[Endless Sword]] served as a master to their disciple, [[Yerin]]. Additionally, [[Eithan]] has mentioned this notable figure in conversation.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|This entity is a master of sword [[Paths]]. They were also one of three [[Sages]] capable of manifesting the [[Sword Icon]].}}
